raw:
The error in the conversation trace is due to WebSurfer incorrectly identifying Princess Adelaide of Löwenstein-Wertheim-Rosenberg as the mother of Infanta Maria Antónia of Portugal, which is not accurate. Maria Antónia's mother is actually Miguel I of Portugal, not Princess Adelaide. This mistake leads to an incorrect conclusion about the maternal grandmother of Elisabeth of Austria.
